name: Kontan
notes: Subdomain per channel (nasional., industri., keuangan., investasi., ...). Body is .tmpt-desk-kon, but its markup is unbalanced so tags, 'Video Terkait' and share bar end up inside it and are removed. Known quirk: the header logo is on a CDN without CORS so the reader falls back to the same-origin Kontan Academy banner image. Kontan Plus premium articles are paywalled: only free articles were checked. /feed/news/<channel> returns 403 to plain clients, so no feed.
